lesson: Nothing improved this mesh. relax declined every setting and the boundary pass had to be undone. The right answer was to stop and say the LAYOUT is the limit -- the 33.7 degree corner is where two singularities sit close together, and no amount of smoothing moves a singularity. Do not keep trying settings on a mesh in this state.
name: british-museum-coarse
remarks: share_below was 0.0, so the low minimum was a single face, not a general condition. relax first because it is the only gated pass.
relax found no setting that improved all three at once, so it left the mesh alone. That is a pass, not a failure.
the ungated boundary pass made aspect worse (5.00 -> 13.05) and was undone. The walls here ARE the mesh own boundary, so there is nothing truer to slide onto.
title: british museum coarse
